description_en: Dissociates an API product from an API by API product ID. This association is established by CreateProductRef on the same resource path and can be queried by GetProductRef
description_zh: 按 API 产品 ID 解除该 API 产品与 API 的关联；该关联由 CreateProductRef 在同一资源路径上建立，可通过 GetProductRef 查询
name: DeleteProductRef

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API product. Specifies the API product from which to dissociate the API. You can obtain this ID from the productId field of a list item returned by ListProducts. This parameter shares the same /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/ref path with CreateProductRef and GetProductRef. This parameter only locates the API product and does not delete the API product itself. To delete an API product, call DeleteProduct
parameters.help_zh: API 产品 ID，指定要解除 API 关联的 API 产品。可由 ListProducts 列表项的 productId 获得，与 CreateProductRef、GetProductRef 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/ref 路径；本参数只定位 API 产品，不删除 API 产品本身（删除产品请使用 DeleteProduct）
parameters.name: product_id
